## About
Primero Auto Parts is an auto parts store in Miami. We keep it simple: the right parts, a fair price, and people who know what they're talking about.
We match or beat any price in town. Shops with a business account can also log in and order through our website.
Customers have given us a 4.3 rating across 296 Google reviews. One first-time customer said they were greeted like a regular, and another said the team took the time to answer all their questions.

## Services
- Auto parts: Parts for your car or your shop, with help from people who know the industry.
- Business accounts: Repair shops and other businesses can sign up for an account and order through our website.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Saturday, 8:30 AM to 1:00 PM. We're closed Sunday.

Q: Can I order on your website?
A: The website is for business accounts only. If you're not a business account, give us a call.

Q: Do you match prices?
A: Yes. We match or beat any price in town.
